zh.text: 纽约大学是位于美国纽约市曼哈顿的私立研究型大学，1831年获纽约州议会特许成立。学校主校区坐落于格林威治村，以华盛顿广场公园为中心。其学术体系涵盖文理、工程、医学、法律及艺术等多个领域，并设有多个专业学院与研究所。此外，纽约大学在布鲁克林设有分校，并在全球多个城市建立了学术中心。

en.text: New York University is a private research university located in New York City, New York, United States. It was chartered in 1831 by the New York State Legislature and founded in 1832. The main campus is situated in Greenwich Village, centered around Washington Square Park. The university offers academic programs in fields such as arts and science, engineering, medicine, law, and business. NYU also maintains a campus in Brooklyn and operates global academic centers in various international cities.
